description: The data of the task.completed with which the Network Monitor closes a node_query (architecture §3.12.3, implementation §10.1). The census travels by Claim-Check in context_ref, with the shape of node_query.census.schema.json; the point form carries the node's signals in the close itself. The common fields are in data.schema.json.

context_ref.description: In the census, where the listing is in the Context Store: the portion census of the query task's section. Its fields are those of data.schema.json.

node_id.description: In the point form, the node the signals are of (architecture §3.12.3).

target_topic.description: In the point form, the topic of the node's specialty (architecture §3.12.3).

signals.description: In the point form, the node's signal vector, with the shape of signals.vector.schema.json, which the validator applies to it (architecture §3.12.2, implementation §10.1).
